def runs(seq):
    out=[]; 
    for v in seq:
        if out and out[-1][0]==v: out[-1][1]+=1
        else: out.append([v,1])
    return out

def loop_cells(h,w):  # rectangle rows0..h-1, cols0..w-1, clockwise from (0,0)
    cells=[(0,c) for c in range(w)]
    cells+=[(r,w-1) for r in range(1,h)]
    cells+=[(h-1,c) for c in range(w-2,-1,-1)]
    cells+=[(r,0) for r in range(h-2,0,-1)]
    return cells

# demo3: frame rows0..24 cols0..24
cells=loop_cells(25,25)
oseq=[O[r][c] for r,c in cells]; iseq=[I[r][c] for r,c in cells]
print("out runs:", runs(oseq))
print("in runs:", [(a,b) for a,b in runs(iseq)])
alt=all(runs(oseq)[i][0]!=runs(oseq)[i+1][0] for i in range(len(runs(oseq))-1))
print("out alternates:", alt, "nruns:", len(runs(oseq)))

# demo4: frame rows4..11 cols3..16
sub_I=[row[3:17] for row in I4[4:12]]
sub_O=[row[3:17] for row in O4[4:12]]
cells4=loop_cells(8,14)
